anchors.paper_title: Affective Calibration of Musical Feature Sets in an Emotionally Intelligent Music Composition System
anchors.reason: Paper covers affective calibration of musical features in a music composition system (same BCMI-MIdAS project) but does not describe this tempo-control BCMI EEG dataset of 19 participants.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1 kHz from 19 participants. Each trial corresponded to a 20 s music clip generated by a synthetic affective music generator. The paradigm was split into 9 runs, the first being a calibration run of 30 trials alternating between increase and decrease tempo.
